name: Tenchou no Osusume!
source:
Tooko Katagiri manages a coffee shop left behind by her parents. She's currently in a pinch, though, as two of her part-time workers decided to quit at the same time.

The recruitment notice she puts up in a hurry gets the attention of two high school seniors.
For the next six months, their life at the cafe will be full of ups and downs.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/5706]Freem![/url]]
translation:
片桐透子经营着父母留下的咖啡店。可如今，两名兼职员工竟同时提出辞职，她顿时陷入窘境。

她匆忙贴出的招聘启事，引来了两名即将毕业的高中生。
从此，店长与两位年轻新人将在咖啡店里度过跌宕起伏的半年。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/5706]Freem![/url]]
